test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)

1) EFINU

2) BCFKR

3) JKNSZ

4) HIMQX
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) EFINU 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b4f5392a63c9a9fb32e430279b3abb2e7edb5099afc2f4ff94442107f9b07a8.png] 

Option 2) JKNSZ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc16fa04e169b5f2f892e4eae7b889cd651ac3d42fad5b02a3af0435640d2231.png] 

Option 3) HIMQX 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ae7e43cc8c82196d59a3a0cd734b3a2fd4615f199a2743eb7a3f7b82f950287.png] 

Option 4) BCFKR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79199da04f0c0b6823c55cca6610e75ca45d566884673380382ee2d8e8d64b21.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "HIMQX" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
